title: 3D Wooden Modeler — Model File (.woodmodel.json)
description: Saved scene produced by saveModel(). Current version: 3. Backwards-compatible loaders handle v1 (no groups), v2 (groups, no rulers) and v3 (groups + rulers).

version.description: Format version. 1 = pieces only; 2 = + groups; 3 = + rulers.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the file was saved.

pieces.description: Ordered list of all scene pieces. Groups are reconstructed from groupId references in a second pass.

type.description: Fixed English identifier for the piece shape. Never translated; used as a discriminator for dimension fields.

id.description: Stable numeric auto-increment ID assigned by addPiece() (pieceCounter). Unique within a saved file but not across files.

label.description: User-editable display name shown as a 3D sprite and in the object list. Null or empty string when not set.

notches.description: Count of CSG Cut Joint operations applied to this piece. Purely informational (used in CSV export).

csgModified.description: True when the piece geometry was altered by at least one Cut Joint. When true, either csgOps (preferred, declarative) or geoPositions+geoNormals (legacy, prebaked) must be present.

price.description: Per-piece price. Interpretation depends on priceMode. 0 for split-part members that belong to a source group (cost counted once via sourcePrice).

priceMode.description: 'fixed' = price is the total cost for this piece. 'per_mm' = price × relevant dimension (length along the split axis for Boards/Dowels) gives the cost.

bought.description: Bought ready-made at its own size (a dowel pin, a turned leg): the cutting plan gives it a piece of stock of its own instead of packing it onto a trade length, and its own price counts. Ignored for split parts and frames. Omitted when false.

sourceId.description: Shared UUID assigned to all parts produced from the same Split operation ('source group'). Null when not a split part.

sourcePrice.description: Original price of the unsplit board/dowel. Used to display the group cost once in the cost summary and CSV. 0 when not a split part.

sourcePriceMode.description: priceMode of the original unsplit piece. Null when not a split part.

sourceLabel.description: Label of the original unsplit piece. Null when not a split part.

sourceLength.description: Length in mm of the original unsplit piece along the split axis. Lets the overview and the cutting plan compute the offcut; without it the offcut is shown as unknown.

sourceKerf.description: Saw kerf in mm used for the split. When missing, the kerf from the Split Piece setting is used.

groupId.description: gId of the THREE.Group this piece belongs to (e.g. 'grp_1'). Null for ungrouped pieces.

rx.description: X rotation in radians (Euler XYZ order).

ry.description: Y rotation in radians (Euler XYZ order).

rz.description: Z rotation in radians (Euler XYZ order).

w.description: Width in mm. Required for Board, Wedge, L-Bracket.

h.description: Height in mm. Required for Board, Wedge, L-Bracket, Dowel, Tapered Leg.

d.description: Depth in mm. Required for Board, Wedge, L-Bracket.

r.description: Radius in mm. Required for Dowel.

rTop.description: Top radius in mm. Required for Tapered Leg.

rBottom.description: Bottom radius in mm. Required for Tapered Leg.

wTop.description: Top width (along x) in mm. Required for Frustum Board and Pyramid Frustum (may be 0 for a wedge-like collapse / pointed apex).

wBottom.description: Bottom width (along x) in mm. Required for Frustum Board and Pyramid Frustum (may be 0).

dTop.description: Top depth (along z) in mm. Required for Pyramid Frustum (may be 0).

dBottom.description: Bottom depth (along z) in mm. Required for Pyramid Frustum (may be 0).

angleStart.description: Optional miter angle in degrees at the -x end face of a Board, measured between the end face and the +x axis when looking down +z. 90° = perpendicular cut (default; field omitted on save when 90). Range (0, 180).

angleEnd.description: Optional miter angle in degrees at the +x end face of a Board (mirror of angleStart). 90° = perpendicular cut (default; field omitted on save when 90). Range (0, 180).

wOuter.description: Outer width in mm. Required for Frame.

hOuter.description: Outer height in mm. Required for Frame.

dOuter.description: Outer depth in mm. Required for Frame.

frameThickness.description: Outer-frame thickness in mm. Required for Frame.

barThickness.description: Interior grid bar thickness in mm. Required for Frame (0 = no bars even when grid > 1).

gridX.description: Number of grid columns (vertical bars = gridX - 1). Required for Frame.

gridY.description: Number of grid rows (horizontal bars = gridY - 1). Required for Frame.

geoPositions.description: Legacy: flat array of vertex XYZ coordinates for CSG-modified geometry (BufferGeometry position attribute). Used for files saved before declarative csgOps existed. New saves use csgOps instead.

geoNormals.description: Legacy: flat array of vertex normal XYZ values for CSG-modified geometry (BufferGeometry normal attribute). Same length as geoPositions. New saves use csgOps instead.

csgOps.description: Declarative list of CSG operations applied to this piece, in order. On load, each op is replayed against a freshly built base mesh after the piece is placed at its world position. Preferred over geoPositions/geoNormals.

op.description: Operation kind. Currently only 'subtract' is supported.

tool.description: Tool piece spec: shape type, dimensions, and transform at the moment of the cut. New saves store the transform in target-local space and set `local: true`; legacy saves store world-space coords with no `local` field. The tool mesh exists only transiently during replay and is disposed afterwards.

local.description: True when px/py/pz/rx/ry/rz are in target-local space. Absent / false in legacy world-space saves.

groups.description: THREE.Group containers. Empty array in v1 files. Pieces reference their group via groupId.

gId.description: Unique group identifier, format 'grp_<n>' where n is a monotonic integer (groupCounter).

rx.description: Group X rotation in radians (Euler XYZ).

ry.description: Group Y rotation in radians (Euler XYZ).

rz.description: Group Z rotation in radians (Euler XYZ).

rulers.description: Persistent measurement lines. Empty array in v1/v2 files.

p1.description: Start point [x, y, z] in world-space mm.

p2.description: End point [x, y, z] in world-space mm.

stock.description: Optional stock material settings for the cutting plan, set under File → Stock Material. One entry per stock cross-section; cross-sections without an entry use the stock catalog of the browser, else the defaults (2000 mm, round stock 1000 mm, raised to the longest part; kerf from Split Piece). Not part of the undo history.

profile.description: Stock cross-section in mm: '<thickness>x<width>' with thickness <= width (e.g. '12x50', '13.5x47'), or 'R<diameter>' for round stock (e.g. 'R6'). Sizes are rounded to 0.1 mm.

name.description: Display name of the stock (e.g. 'Leiste', 'Plywood'). Omitted for the automatic name (strip, board, square strip, dowel rod).

length.description: Single length the stock is bought in, in mm, without a price. Older form of offers with one entry; offers wins when both are present.

offers.description: Lengths the stock is sold in, each with an optional price. The cutting plan packs the parts onto the cheapest mix; when not every offer has a price it minimizes the stock length bought. Written from the stock catalog on save when the project has no own offers, so the file plans the same on another computer. The global stock catalog (browser storage, exported as .woodstock.json) uses the same entry shape: profile, name, offers.

price.description: Price of one piece of this length, in the currency chosen in the app. Omitted when unknown.

kerf.description: Saw blade thickness in mm, taken by every cut.

parts.description: Part cross-sections (same format as profile) sawn from this stock instead of their own cross-section, e.g. ripped battens '12x37.2' from '12x50'. Ignored for a part cross-section whose parts do not all fit.

stockOptions.description: Optional options of the cutting plan, set under File → Stock Material. Not part of the undo history.

repackSplit.description: Pack parts split in the model (Split Piece) onto stock like all other parts, instead of keeping them on the piece they were split from. Omitted when false.
